title.rendered: Best Ideas on How to Hire Developers in Luxembourg

content.rendered:
Luxembourg has been one of the most successful and yet the smallest European countries. Being the major hub of the European Union (EU) financial services sphere, as The Bulletin Focus states, Luxembourg is also known for its powerful IT sector.

IT Market in Luxembourg: An Overview

The IT team augmentation Luxembourg is currently on an upward trend, boasting a commendable growth rate. According to data from Statista, the IT industry has witnessed a growth rate of 7.43%. The consistent rise shows the country’s commitment to tech innovations and its ability to keep pace with the dynamic digital age.

In a country known for its banking strength, Luxembourg’s IT sector has emerged distinctively. With around 2,200 software development companies in Luxembourg, on LinkedIn, the country shows its robust governmental support and aptitude to draw both tech giants and startups.

With a thriving IT market, the country employs about 20.4 thousand software developer Luxembourg. This reflects the Grand Duchy’s commitment to fostering tech education and its rich pool of skilled tech talent.

Luxembourg’s tech sector extends beyond its borders, with exports valued at $806 million according to the World Bank. This highlights its significant role in both European and global IT landscapes.
In Luxembourg programming landscape, Java, Python, JavaScript, C++, and C# are the leading languages, showcasing the diverse tech initiatives companies are undertaking in the region.

According to TechRepublic, the most demanded and popular positions in the IT sector are as follows in 2017:

  • Ruby on Rails programmers
  • iOS and Android developers
  • Information security software experts
  • IoT programmers
  • JavaScript experts
  • Cloud developers with open systems (SQL, Java) or .NET experience (MVC, ASP.NET, SQL Server, C#)
  • Full stack developers
  • Machine learning engineers
  • DevOps professionals
  • UX/UI developers

Luxembourg Is the Most Developed IT Country After the USA

According to The Bulletin Focus, Luxembourg’s contribution to GDP of the EU is 6% and its employment rate is also very high –  6.4m people employed. According to the economic research conducted by Atradius, there are no precise forecasts nowadays, but Luxembourg will surely be a major player in the financial services realignment.

IT sector in Luxembourg is quickly growing, as A.T.Kearney report claims. More and more industries engage information technologies and introduce them in their businesses, so IT has all the chances to become one of the most wanted industries in Luxembourg in future. Logically, the report presumes, if one wants to hire developers in Luxembourg, it could be quite a challenge due to the popularity of the profession and high density of IT companies in the country. Because of its popularity, the Luxembourg developer will not be cheap.

Software Developer Landscape in Luxembourg’s Cities

The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, while small in size, boasts a dynamic tech ecosystem that is growing across its cities. Each city, with its unique charm and infrastructure, offers diverse opportunities for software developer Luxembourg. Let’s delve into the specific landscapes of five key cities in terms of average web developer salary in Luxembourg and the community size.

  • Luxembourg

As the capital city and the most prominent urban hub, Luxembourg has a significant concentration of software developers. The average full stack developer salary Luxembourg is €4.500 which is higher than in other regions of the country, reflecting the city’s economic status. The exact number of developers in the city is 1900.

  • Esch-sur-Alzette

Esch-sur-Alzette, known for its cultural vibrancy and industrial heritage, is seeing a rise in the tech industry. The average salary of a software developer in Esch-sur-Alzette is €4.100. The number of developers choosing to work and settle in this city is also growing, currently estimated at 300 people.

  • Dudelange

Dudelange, a charming city with a blend of modernity and history, has started to make its mark in the IT sector. The average salary of a software developer here stands at €4.000. While it may not have the same density as Luxembourg city, the number of developers in Dudelange is estimated at 84 people.

  • Schifflange

Schifflange, with its rich history and evolving urban landscape, offers opportunities for tech enthusiasts. Software developers in Schifflange have an average salary of €4.300. The community of developers in this city, though smaller compared to larger cities, stands at 55 people.

  • Bettembourg

Bettembourg, known for its scenic beauty and castle, is also becoming a spot for tech professionals. The software developers in this picturesque city earn an average salary of €5.200. The current number of developers residing and working in Bettembourg is 45 people.

Finding a Dedicated Team in Luxembourg

A dedicated team of developers in Luxembourg is a group of IT experts that you hire from an outsourcing software development company Luxembourg for your project. It may include web developers, software engineers, designers, WordPress developer in Luxembourg depending on the specifics of your future product.

You can hire them by means of outsourcing (project-based model) and dedicated development teams model, this means they will become a part of your project team, but will work as remote employees.

According to the report published by Whitelane Research investigating nearly 200 companies, outsourcing activities in Luxembourg are expected to grow. 85% of all respondents of the research said they will continue to outsource, and 51% claimed they plan to outsource even more.

FAQ: Hiring Developers in Luxembourg

  • Why is Luxembourg considered an attractive location for hiring developers?

Luxembourg, located in the very center of Europe, offers a strong economy, progressive IT policies, and top-tier infrastructure. Its diverse, multilingual workforce and cosmopolitan culture further enhance its appeal, drawing skilled developers globally.

  • What is the average cost of hiring a developer in Luxembourg?

The cost of hiring a PHP developer Luxembourg depends on experience, technology expertise, and project specifics. Generally, salaries are higher here than in many European countries due to its affluent economy. For exact figures, refer to current market research or hiring platforms.

  • How does the quality of developers in Luxembourg compare to other European countries?

Luxembourg’s developers are renowned for their expertise and adaptability, backed by a strong education system. While Europe has many tech hubs, The Grand Duchy stands out for its multilingual and tech-savvy full stack developer Luxembourg talent pool.

  • What are the legal considerations for hiring developers in Luxembourg?

In Luxembourg, employers must follow national labor laws, including work hours, vacation, and social benefits. Being in the EU, they also need to comply with GDPR and data protection, crucial for IT firms handling user data.
